$comment: Coreloom UI registry items this site uses. Update them with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @coreloom/<name> --overwrite`, or from a local coreloom-ui checkout with `node scripts/sync-coreloom.mjs <path-to-coreloom-ui>`. Installed files are ours: review the diff after an update, Atlas adaptations live in src/components/atlas/.
